source.attribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, Table 20-10-0074-01 Wholesale trade, sales, July 2026. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
source.limitations: Canada and Statistics Canada already appear in the previous RETAIL corpus; these WHOLESALE labels and industry taxonomies are new, not a new independent country/provider. National parent aggregates and geographic totals excluded. Provinces share revisions and macroeconomic shocks. Northwest Territories included Nunavut before 1999, so this overlapping pre-1999 Northwest Territories history is made unusable. Monthly unadjusted estimates revised back to 2012 with the May 2017 sample change; current-vintage histories are not historical vintages. Oilseed/grain and petroleum detailed reporting starts 2023. No borrower revenue, expense, repayment or default labels.
source.published_status_policy: Numeric A excellent/B very good/C good/D acceptable/E use with caution and unflagged/provisional/revised published values accepted, matching existing Canadian retail quality policy. F unreliable, x confidential, .. missing and absent calendar cells remain null, never zero. E is retained with its original flag, never relabelled high quality.
source.source_availability_note: US Census direct XLSX/bulk downloads returned 403 and the API requires a key. FRED redistribution was excluded because its current terms prohibit software/system/ML development or training. Singapore data researched only as an alternative and not used. No model scores drove this source substitution.
source.taxonomy_policy: All 32 numeric deepest published NAICS leaves, no selected ancestor/descendant pair. Exclusion subtotal codes and national Canada total omitted. All 13 nonoverlapping provinces/territories retained before missing-window exclusions. Calendar gaps before a category exists are explicit null; newer leaves may have only recent eligible cases.
source.title: Statistics Canada Table 20-10-0074-01 Wholesale trade, sales; unadjusted province/territory deepest disjoint NAICS leaves
source.units: thousand CAD, current prices, not seasonally adjusted
